Repeated2cm panel-joint beams, tiny mast joints and per-panel face subdivisions are omitted; continuous shared stainless panels replace painted-metal/stainless duplicate surface groups. Shared stainless tinted silver approximates aluminium, and opaque glass approximates reflective vision glass and the real clear drum. Skyline has sparse five-floor ribbons, six-segment bow, one-floor coarse drum, five crown slits and triangular roof/mast; canopy/apron, door casings, fine curtain mullions, beacon frame bands and maintenance arms are omitted. District restores canopy/apron/doors, four drum belts, three-floor ribbons, twelve-segment bow and sparse diagonal roof grid. Street restores every floor datum, eight drum belts, facade mullions, denser bow/roof sampling, slits, sill projections and maintenance arms. Close-up adds dense drum glazing, beacon bands and fine roof grid. Original intermediate base/crown datums, bow/radius, panel/mullion pitches and canopy/door dimensions remain photo reconstructions; only overall published height, side, floor-to-floor pitch and major forms/counts are primary. Current architect NORR rounds total height360m and counts52office floors; contractor gives354m/54floor office, while architect-contributed book uses355m/54. Selected original355m is retained; no forced agreement is claimed. Common retail complex, interiors, landscaping and neighboring Museum of the Future are excluded. Actual physical-device/dense-city timings and surveyed entrance/curb fit remain unmeasured. The merged branch changed model geometry since the previous approval. The current source generator/import reproduced the currently declared master bytes, all six GLBs were validated, and fresh portable, shared-material/geographic-flat and Earth-context images were inspected. Existing focused tests verify the current distinguishing geometry, signed footprint and browser budgets. The current review supersedes the previous geometry/hash approval; it does not claim unchanged GLBs relative to that older approval. Existing reference/placement scope remains explicit.
